content.title: What is the release date for The Boys season 5 episode 3 on Prime Video?
content.text: What will Soldier Boy and Homelander's next move be in The Boys season 5? (Image credit: Prime Video/Jasper Savage) Who's ready for another round of The Boys? I'm guessing you are, otherwise you wouldn't be here to find out when season 5 episode 3 will be released.Below, I've compiled a list of the launch dates and times you need to know about for the Amazon TV Original's next chapter. At the end of this piece, there's a full episode release schedule for the R-rated show's fifth and final season, so you can see when you'll need to set time aside to stream the rest of it. So, let's light this candle and proceed together…What is the launch time for The Boys season 5 episode 3?The Boys season 5 episode 3 will make its bow on Wednesday (Image credit: Prime Video)The Boys season 5's third entry will make its Prime Video debut on Wednesday, April 15. That's a global release date, too, so viewers in North and South America won't be able to watch it earlier than everyone else.Article continues below Latest Videos From TechRadarThis week's installment will drop on Amazon's streaming platform at the same time that The Boys season 5's two-episode premiere did, too. Need a reminder of the time you need to tune into one of the world's best streaming services? I've got you:US — Wednesday, April 15 at 12am PT / 3am ETCanada — Wednesday, April 15 at 12am PT / 3am ETUK — Wednesday, April 15 at 8amIndia — Wednesday, April 15 at 12:30pm ISTSingapore — Wednesday, April 15 at 3pm SGTAustralia — Wednesday, April 15 at 5pm AEDTNew Zealand — Wednesday, April 15 at 7pm NZDTWhen do new episodes of The Boys season 5 come out?The final five episodes of the season will air every Wednesday until the TV series' last-ever chapter arrives on May 20. That will be the case as long as Amazon doesn't suddenly decide to alter this season's release schedule, anyway.If it doesn't — and there's no reason to suspect it will — these are the all-important release dates you need to be aware of:The Boys season 5 episode 1 — out nowThe Boys season 5 episode 2 — out nowThe Boys season 5 episode 3 — April 15The Boys season 5 episode 4 — April 22The Boys season 5 episode 5 — April 29The Boys season 5 episode 6 — May 6The Boys season 5 episode 7 — May 13The Boys season 5 episode 8 — May 20Follow TechRadar on Google News and add us as a preferred source to get our expert news, reviews, and opinion in your feeds.
